scope: Retrospective repeat of all44 previously timing-confounded targets, both original period bands, dropping entire QLP99-104 products. All original175 products/results remain unchanged.

screen_survivors.disposition: Not a robust transit candidate: raw local combined3.89sigma and reassigned holdout0.19sigma.

Persistent timing-clean dimming but too broad for catalog-density circular transit and much deeper in latest seasons; Gaia closecompanion/RUWE10.38 reported by catalog agent. Source/nature unresolved; not a defensible planet detection.

caution: Timing-safe subset results supersede timing-confounded vetoes only for this restricted data. Reassigned holdouts were inspected in previous pipeline development and are retrospective. No survey completeness or uniformly robust planet-absence claim.
